description: Every PRD requirement traced to policy, code, and the tests that prove it. A requirement that is not fully implemented must declare a gap; undeclared gaps fail npm run prd:eval.

requirements.title: Morning slots book by 8:00 PM the previous evening

tests.name: sets morning cutoff to 8 PM the previous day

requirements.title: Evening slots book by 3:00 PM the same day

tests.name: sets evening cutoff to 3 PM the same day

prd.quote: One of the four fixed departures on a date (7:30, 8:30, 5:00, 6:00)

requirements.title: One booking per employee per date

prd.quote: An employee holds one booking on a date.

tests.name: creates a booking, then rejects a second booking the same day

requirements.title: Cancel until one hour before the slot starts

prd.quote: cancel until one hour before the slot starts

tests.name: allows cancel until 1 hour before slot start

requirements.title: Two consecutive no-shows block booking for the next day

prd.quote: After two consecutive no-shows, the employee can still sign in and cannot book for the next day.

tests.name: sets a 1-day block after two consecutive no-shows
marks no-show and blocks after two consecutive no-shows
rejects booking for a blocked user

requirements.title: Only an admin can view a day's bookings, tag a vehicle, and mark no-shows

prd.quote: Only an admin can view a day’s bookings, tag a vehicle on each booking, and mark no-shows.

plan.quote: ## 1. Admin-only day view, vehicle tag, and no-show

requirements.gap: Not enforced. GET /api/bookings, PATCH /api/bookings/:id/vehicle, and PATCH /api/bookings/:id/no-show do not check is_admin, and the Admin tab shows for every employee.

requirements.title: Employees book and cancel only for themselves

plan.quote: ## 2. Bookings and cancels belong to the signed-in employee

requirements.gap: Not enforced. POST /api/bookings and POST /api/chat/bookings accept any user_id in the body, and PATCH /api/bookings/:id/cancel cancels any booking.

requirements.title: Employees sign in with Trimble ID

prd.quote: Employees sign in with Trimble ID.

requirements.gap: Partly implemented. The login page offers Trimble ID, but the API does not require a Trimble ID token, so email sign-in reaches booking and admin actions.

requirements.title: No booking on weekends or public holidays

prd.quote: Cutoffs, one booking per date, weekends, holidays, and the one-hour cancel window still apply.

code.quote: Booking not available on public holidays.

tests.name: rejects weekends and listed public holidays

requirements.gap: The baseline PRD (workride-prd.md) never states this rule; only the chat PRD refers to it as already applying. Add it to the baseline PRD.

requirements.title: Chat-only urgent override for three categories

tests.name: accepts only the three urgent categories with a 15 to 500 character explanation
books from chat for each urgent category and leaves the block in place
refuses a chat booking for a blocked user without a valid urgent reason

requirements.title: Urgent explanation is 15 to 500 characters after trimming

tests.name: accepts only the three urgent categories with a 15 to 500 character explanation

requirements.title: The Book page keeps the hard block

prd.quote: A blocked employee can sign in and cannot book there.

policy.quote: They do not accept an urgent override.

tests.name: keeps the web booking path blocked even when an urgent reason is sent

requirements.title: Override booking is tagged and the block stays in place

prd.quote: That booking is tagged with the category, the explanation, and source `chat`. `blocked_until` stays in place.

tests.name: books from chat for each urgent category and leaves the block in place

requirements.title: Base rules still apply to an urgent chat booking

prd.quote: An urgent reason does not move those rules.

tests.name: still rejects a weekend and a past cutoff on the chat path

requirements.title: Chat may book one trip while the employee is blocked

prd.quote: Chat may book one trip when the employee is blocked

tests.name: books from chat for each urgent category and leaves the block in place

requirements.gap: Ambiguous. The code allows one trip per request with a valid reason and no limit during the block (the test books three). Decide whether "one trip" means one per block, then add a limit or reword the PRD.

requirements.title: Chat is a page

prd.quote: Employees can book the same four slots in a Chat page.

requirements.gap: Out of date. Chat shipped as a floating chat bot on every page, not a separate Chat page. Reword the PRD.
